sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 5749 of 2025

Applicant :- Devesh Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Ghan Shyam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anuj Chaturvedi,G.A.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Affidavit of compliance filed by the learned A.G.A. is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent, and perused the entire record.
3.

This application has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge-sheet dated 19.01.2012 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 06.04.2023 passed by Civil Judge (Junior Division), Auraiya and entire proceedings of Case No.72 of 2013 (State v. Devesh Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No.222 of 2011, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Ajeetmal, District Auraiya pending in the Court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Auraiya, on the basis of a compromise.

entities.text: Case No.72 of 2013 (State v. Devesh Kumar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that since the parties had settled their dispute outside the court, therefore, concerned S.H.O. was directed to verify the compromise vide order dated 20.05.2025.

It is further submitted that since parties have settled the dispute, opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed with trial, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the Devesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62646791/
1 matter pending.

entities.text: Devesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that from perusal of the verification report, it is revealed that applicant has solemnized marriage with the victim/opposite party no.2.
Since the dispute between the parties has been settled and opposite party no.2 has no objection, therefore, the proceedings of the aforesaid case pending before the trial court be quashed.
6. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, and have gone through the entire record.

7. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.
8.

In such circumstances, the entire proceedings of charge-sheet dated 19.01.2012 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 06.04.2023 passed by Civil Judge (Junior Division), Auraiya and entire proceedings of Case No.72 of 2013 (State v. Devesh Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No.222 of 2011, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Ajeetmal, District Auraiya pending in the Court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Auraiya, against the applicant, are hereby quashed.
